data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is excited to present this stunning 1-bedroom apartment in Binghatti Heights, Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai, UAE.

Unit Details:

1 Bedroom
2 Bathrooms
1 Parking Space
Fully Furnished
Marina View
Ready to Move In
Vacant

Experience elevated urban living in this beautifully furnished 1-bedroom apartment nestled in the iconic Binghatti Heights, one of JVC's most sought-after residential towers. Thoughtfully designed with a contemporary aesthetic, the unit features two bathrooms, floor-to-ceiling windows that frame breathtaking Marina views making every morning feel like a retreat.

The apartment comes fully furnished and is move-in ready, ideal for professionals or couples seeking a hassle-free transition into their new home. Residents enjoy access to premium shared amenities including a rooftop pool, state-of-the-art gym, and landscaped communal areas. Covered parking and 24-hour security are included for added peace of mind.

Strategically located in JVC, you're minutes away from Circle Mall, an array of dining options, supermarkets, and well-regarded schools such as JSS International and Sunmarke School. With seamless connectivity to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, commuting across Dubai is effortless.
